description: This is a Java source file defining a REST controller (HelloController) in a Spring Boot application. It provides basic endpoints such as a welcome message, API documentation redirection, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic HTTP GET endpoints for welcome message, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message when accessing the root endpoint '/'

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI documentation, preserving request scheme, host, and port

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' status indicating the application's health

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides basic information about the application
